record.title: Evaluate separate-field guest baseline
record.intent: Select the next bounded offline or guest entitlement step.
requirements: Reconcile exact field behavior and modeled private state before selecting a successor.
A successful baseline supports one guest ordinary installation with process and reboot persistence; a failure requires a bounded correction or recorded dependency.
No physical installation, capability change, reboot or acquisition. Commit and push decision and admitted tasking before successor execution.
acceptance: The continuation follows actual evidence without conflating guest and physical state.
